description: The fixed vocabularies of the Jobo jobs API: work models, employment types, experience levels, company categories, languages (ISO 639-1), sort orders, description formats and `include_fields`, plus the feed's company size and revenue bands. Use them for enums, constants and validation in the code you write. Values are lowercase and canonical: send them verbatim. Jobs come back with display-cased values (`Remote`, `Full-time`), which are not valid filter input. No API key and no network call: it answers from the filter contract this server ships with. For open vocabularies (companies, skills, industries, occupations, sources, places) use the `find_` tools.
name: list_filters
title: List fixed filter values
